question: Does an Adobe Font Metrics glyph record preserve its decimal or hexadecimal character code and horizontal width?
control: The same record preserves the glyph name A.
domain: Widths from 0 through 1023. Even widths use decimal C 65 and odd widths use hexadecimal CH <41>. The high word holds the code and the low word holds the width.
assistance: curator-supplied public caller and expected results only in the matched lane
